title: Dirt Recipe
description: This mod adds Craftable Dirt to Minecraft, making it possible to craft dirt in Survival mode.
body:
This mod adds Craftable Dirt to Minecraft, making it possible to craft dirt in Survival mode.
It is designed to stay balanced, so the recipe is not too cheap or overpowered. This helps players who run out of dirt while building, terraforming, or playing on Skyblock worlds.

The mod keeps the vanilla Minecraft feeling while giving players a simple and useful new crafting option. It is easy to use, survival-friendly, and fits naturally into normal gameplay.
